assignments.name: why_hire
assignments.value: ={{ $json['Cover Letter / Why do you want this role?'] }}

parameters.subject: =Application Received — {{ $json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $json.name }},

Thank you for applying for the {{ $json.position }} position at our company.

We have received your application and our HR team will review your portfolio shortly. You will hear from us within 3–5 business days.

Your Application ID: {{ $json.applicant_id }}
Keep this ID for your reference.

Best regards,
HR Team
Animaster Studio

parameters.subject: =Update on Your Application — {{ $('Get Applicant - Score Reject').item.json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $('Get Applicant - Score Reject').item.json.name }},

Thank you for applying for the {{ $('Get Applicant - Score Reject').item.json.position }} position and for taking the time to share your portfolio with us.

After careful review, we regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.

We encourage you to apply again in the future and wish you the best in your career.

Best regards,
HR Team
Animaster Studio

parameters.text:
=❌ Rejection email sent to ({{ $('Get Applicant - Score Reject').item.json.name }} - {{ $('Get Applicant - Score Reject').item.json.position }})
Score: {{ $('Parse SCORE Command').item.json.score }}/100

parameters.subject: =You've Been Shortlisted! — {{ $('Get Applicant - Shortlist').item.json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $('Get Applicant - Shortlist').item.json.name }},

Congratulations! After reviewing your portfolio, we are pleased to inform you that you have been shortlisted for the {{ $('Get Applicant - Shortlist').item.json.position }} position.

Our team will contact you shortly to schedule an interview.

Please be available and keep an eye on your email.

Best regards,
HR Team
Animaster Studio

parameters.text:
=Shortlist email sent to {{ $('Get Applicant - Shortlist').item.json.name }} ({{ $('Get Applicant - Shortlist').item.json.position }})
Score: {{ $('Parse SCORE Command').item.json.score }}/100

parameters.subject: =Job Offer Letter {{ $('Get Applicant - Selected').item.json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $('Get Applicant - Selected').item.json.name }},

Congratulations! After your interview, you have been officially selected for the {{ $('Get Applicant - Selected').item.json.position }} position at Animaster Studio!

Your Joining Date: {{ $('Parse RESULT Command').item.json.joining_date }}

Please confirm your acceptance by replying to this email. We will share further onboarding details shortly.

Best regards,
HR Team
Animaster Studio

parameters.text: =🎉 {{ $('Get Applicant - Selected').item.json.name }} has been SELECTED for {{ $('Get Applicant - Selected').item.json.position }}! Offer email sent successfully.

parameters.subject: =Job Offer — {{ $('Get Applicant - Rejected').item.json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $('Get Applicant - Rejected').item.json.name }},

Thank you for attending the interview for the {{ $('Get Applicant - Rejected').item.json.position }} position. It was a pleasure speaking with you.

After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.

We wish you all the best in your future endeavors.

Best regards,
HR Team
Animaster Studio

parameters.text:
